spondylopathies (ICD-9: 720; ICD-10-CA: M45.x, M46.1, M46.8, M46.9), and arthropathy associated with other disorders classified elsewhere (ICD-9: 713m; ICD-10-CA: M07.4, M07.5, M07.6).
